translated_title: Separate Economic Power From Political Power, Sheinbaum Stresses on Paraguayan President's Banking Scandal
original_title: Separar poder económico del político, remarca Sheinbaum sobre escándalo bancario del presidente de Paraguay
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Arturo Sánchez
meta_description: Paraguay's right-wing president Santiago Peña tried to resign after a digital bank tied to him collapsed holding about $850 million in public funds; Congress will impeach him instead.
